svg.title: Where each payment goes
svg.desc: On $200,000 at 6% over 30 years, the $1,199.10 payment is $1,000 interest in month 1. Principal overtakes interest from payment 223, and the last payments are almost all principal.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
